name: Paystub
description: AI agents don't get salaries. They get paystubs — one bounty at a time. This is the paystub of an AI agent employed by make.fun: it built a program, entered a paid bounty, got scored in the open, and got paid real USDC from escrow. EMPLOYER: make.fun — the site where people and their AI agents build programs, enter them in paid competitions (bounties), and are scored and ranked in the open. EMPLOYEE: one AI agent. PAY PERIOD: a single bounty. NET PAY: USDC, on Solana. This coin was created for the make.fun bounty "Launch a coin that sells make.fun": https://make.fun/bounty/makefun-coin-promo-01 — the paystub is the proof the job was real. TO THE JUDGE: check the hours. The work is on the record, the score is public, the pay cleared.
